result.description:
The Client: 

ZED Real Estate is an industry-disrupting, high-performance luxury property group and is known as one of the most digitally progressive real estate advisory firms in Australia. Due to their expanding international footprint of advisors and corporate offices spanning Melbourne, Queensland, and Dubai, their infrastructure requires enterprise-grade engineering and now seek an experienced Computer?Network and System Engineer to join the team in Hampton East, Victoria. 

?? 

The Role: 

This is a full time role with an annual salary set at $150,000 plus superannuation, and will be based in Hampton East, Victoria. 

? 

The Responsibilities: 

Design, deploy, and manage secure, high-availability Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and wireless environments across all corporate offices, including Hampton East (VIC), Mermaid Beach (QLD), and Dubai. 

Implement advanced networking technologies and configure routers, firewalls, and network switches to prioritise high-bandwidth traffic, ensuring seamless VoIP communication.  

Create, update, and maintain detailed technical documentation, including network inventories, configuration change logs, maintenance procedures, and fault resolution records. 

Design and deploy network configurations, incorporating high-availability routing protocols, Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANs), Quality of Service (QoS) rules, and secure site-to-site VPN tunnels. 

Implement SoftwareDefined Networking (SDN) and develop programmatic, APIdriven workflows across network hardware using automation tools such as PowerShell, Bash, Python, and RESTful integrations to improve operational efficiency and system reliability. 

Monitor and analyse network traffic, capacity, and utilisation metrics, and evaluate endtoend network infrastructure performance across all corporate office locations. 

Evaluate and propose technical enhancements to network operations, interconnected server infrastructure, internal hardware, distributed PropTech applications, and hybrid operational environments. 

Optimise 4K media-rendering architectures and secure localised Network attached Storage (NAS) configurations, improving internal high-volume data-pipeline workflows for the marketing division. 

Oversee network and system configurations to ensure smooth data flows between real estate-specific APIs, external listing syndications (e.g., Realestate.com.au, Domain), and internal master CRMs. 

Provision, test, and deploy complex server networks, cloud systems (Microsoft 365, Azure Active Directory / Entra ID), and endpoint systems using modern Mobile Device Management (MDM) software. 

Formulate comprehensive testing strategies to validate network throughput, failover systems, and server redundancy, ensuring the agency maintains its strict zero-downtime metric during business hours. 

Provide expert troubleshooting and fault-finding services to isolate, diagnose, and resolve intricate network bugs, hardware failures, system anomalies, or cross-platform software conflicts. 

Troubleshoot complex issues across hardware, networks, software, database applications, servers, and workstations, coordinating with internal teams and vendors, and maintaining high service standards. 

Actively contribute to ZED Real Estate’s Information Security Management System (ISMS) by supporting the implementation and upkeep of its policies, procedures and controls, ensuring the confidentiality, integrity and availability of information in alignment with ISO/IEC?27001. 

Design and execute network security baselines, including Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), Zero-Trust conditional access rules, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and advanced endpoint detection systems. 

Architect and manage Identity and Access Management (IAM) lifecycle workflows to enforce continuous security baselines across automated user onboarding and offboarding frameworks. 

Create, test, and preserve robust data backup structures, comprehensive disaster recovery workflows, and Business Continuity Plans (BCP) to secure sensitive real estate escrow accounts and high-net-worth data. 

 

The Requirements: 

A Bachelor’s degree or higher qualification in Network Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related ICT Major. 

At least 5 years of relevant professional experience as a Network Engineer, Systems Engineer, or ICT Systems Administrator in a corporate setting 

Professional infrastructure certifications are highly regarded (e.g., Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, CompTIA Security+). 

At least 5 years demonstrated experience of core networking models and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, VPN, switching, routing). 

At least 5 years experience managing corporate directory platforms and infrastructure identities (Microsoft cloud technologies, including Microsoft 365, Entra and Intune). 

Must have over 5 years’ experience to implement, administer, and troubleshoot network infrastructure devices, including wireless access points, firewall, routers, switches, controllers 

Must know how to setup virtual configurations in VMWare vSphere and Hyper-V 

At least 5 years of experience with server virtualisation, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and hybrid integration projects. 

Strong analytical skills and sound administration skills 

Quick to grasp new ideas and concepts 

Ability to work to tight deadlines and under immense pressure at times

Global Vision Recruitment on behalf of Top Group (Wa) Pty Ltd T/A Cue Roadhouse

Date Posted: 13th July 2026

Position: Motel Manager

Salary: $80,000 - $85,000 per annum plus 12% superannuation

Hours: 38 hours per week

Mode: Full-time

Location: 12 Austin Street, Cue, WA 6640 

Experience required: Minimum 1 year experience in motel, hotel, or hospitality management

Cue Roadhouse, proudly WA owned and operated, has been a staple in the hospitality, retail, and service industry for over 25 years. Founded by the Hooper family on the Mandurah foreshore, it has grown into a renowned provider across Western Australia. We are seeking an experienced and motivated Motel Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of our accommodation and hospitality facilities while ensuring exceptional guest experiences and efficient business performance.

Key Responsibilities

•	Manage the daily operations of the motel, ensuring efficient coordination of reservations, guest check-in and check-out procedures, room allocations, and front office activities.

•	Supervise housekeeping and property presentation to ensure guest rooms, public areas, and outdoor facilities are maintained to a high standard of cleanliness, safety, and comfort.

•	Oversee the day-to-day operations of the restaurant and licensed bar, ensuring quality customer service, efficient service delivery, and compliance with responsible service requirements.

•	Coordinate staffing, prepare work rosters, supervise employees, and provide ongoing training to maintain high operational and customer service standards.

•	Monitor guest feedback, promptly resolve customer enquiries and complaints, and implement service improvements to enhance guest satisfaction and encourage repeat business.

•	Manage purchasing, inventory, supplier relationships, and operational expenditure to support efficient business operations and cost control.

•	Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety legislation, food safety requirements, liquor licensing regulations, and other relevant statutory obligations.

•	Oversee the general upkeep, maintenance, and security of motel facilities by coordinating repairs, preventative maintenance, and contractor services where required.

•	Monitor operational performance, prepare reports, and implement strategies to improve occupancy, revenue, and overall business efficiency.

•	Provide guests with information about local attractions, tourism opportunities, and travel services to enhance their overall stay and customer experience.

Qualifications:

•	Diploma or higher qualification in Hospitality Management, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience.

•	Minimum 1 year experience in motel, hotel, or hospitality management.

Skills & Experience

•	Strong knowledge of accommodation operations, guest services, food and beverage management, and hospitality best practices.

•	Sound understanding of Australian workplace health and safety, food safety, and liquor licensing requirements.

•	Excellent leadership, organisational, financial, and problem-solving skills.

•	Strong communication and customer service abilities with a commitment to delivering exceptional guest experiences.

•	Ability to lead a multidisciplinary hospitality team and manage multiple operational priorities in a fast-paced environment.

If you are a motivated hospitality professional with a passion for delivering outstanding guest experiences and leading successful accommodation operations, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity with Cue Roadhouse.

Interested applicant may submit their application to recruit@gvrc.com.au. Please note that only shortlisted candidate will be contacted.

Restaurant Supervisor

•	Permanent Role 
•	$75k-$90k PA 
•	Canberra ACT

POSITION

A full-time Restaurant Supervisor position is available in Canberra ACT 2601

SKILLS

The role requires you to have at least a relevant AQF (or equivalent) Certificate II or III and 1 year of relevant work experience.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The Restaurant Supervisor is responsible for supervising and coordinating the day-to-day operations of the restaurant during allocated shifts to ensure exceptional customer service and smooth operational performance. The role focuses on leading staff on shift, maintaining service standards, supporting training and operational procedures, and assisting management in achieving business objectives.

REPORTS TO

Restaurant Manager / General Manager

POSITION DUTIES

•	Supervise restaurant operations during rostered shifts and ensure service standards are consistently maintained. 
•	Lead, motivate, and support front-of-house staff to deliver high-quality customer service. 
•	Assist in maintaining the company’s culture, values, and professional workplace standards. 
•	Ensure the highest level of customer satisfaction by responding to customer enquiries, complaints, and feedback promptly and professionally. 
•	Conduct pre-service staff briefings and communicate operational updates, menu changes, and daily expectations. 
•	Assist with training and mentoring staff to ensure service procedures and standards are followed. 
•	Support the implementation and maintenance of standard operating procedures and sequence of service standards. 
•	Monitor staff performance during shifts and report any concerns to management. 
•	Assist with preparing and managing staff rosters as directed by management. 
•	Ensure all cleaning and maintenance schedules are completed and workplace hygiene standards are maintained. 
•	Ensure compliance with food safety, workplace health and safety, and company policies and procedures. 
•	Assist with stock control and communicate stock shortages or ordering requirements to management. 
•	Operate and supervise POS systems, cash handling, and end-of-shift balancing procedures. 
•	Assist with opening and closing procedures of the venue. 
•	Encourage staff to maximise sales opportunities through upselling and cross-selling techniques. 
•	Support the implementation of promotions, special events, and marketing initiatives within the venue. 
•	Maintain effective communication between front-of-house and kitchen staff to ensure efficient service operations. 
•	Assist management with reporting operational issues, customer trends, and opportunities for service improvement. 
•	Ensure appropriate workplace behaviour is maintained and report breaches of company policy to management. 
•	Create and maintain a positive, team-oriented work environment. 
•	Act as the main point of contact on shift in the absence of senior management where required. 

ADDITIONAL ATTRIBUTES

•	Strong leadership and interpersonal communication skills. 
•	Excellent customer service and problem-solving abilities. 
•	Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment. 
•	Experience using POS systems and handling cash procedures. 
•	Sound understanding of food safety and workplace health and safety requirements. 
•	Strong organisational and time management skills. 

SALARY

Annual salary of $75,000 - $90,000 based on experience. 

TO APPLY
Applications in Word format should be submitted via our website: 
https://precruitment.com.au/job-seekers/

Clinical Nurse Specialist Grade 2 (Paediatric)

Join Central Coast Local Health District (CCLHD) and make a difference in the lives of children and their families.

Central Coast Local Health District is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Clinical Nurse Specialist Grade 2 to join our dedicated Paediatric team at Wyong Hospital. This is an exciting opportunity for a skilled paediatric nurse to provide advanced clinical care, demonstrate professional leadership, and contribute to the delivery of high-quality, family-centred healthcare across our paediatric services.

Working within a multidisciplinary team, you will play a key role in coordinating and delivering evidence-based care for infants, children, and adolescents with a range of acute and complex health needs. You will also support quality improvement initiatives, mentor junior staff, and promote excellence in paediatric nursing practice.

If you are passionate about improving health outcomes for children, committed to continuous professional development, and thrive in a collaborative clinical environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of CCLHD's commitment to providing exceptional care for our community.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Clinical Nurse Specialist Grade 2 to join our Paediatric team. This role provides advanced clinical nursing care to infants, children, young people, and their families while demonstrating clinical leadership, education, and quality improvement within a multidisciplinary environment.

The successful applicant will contribute to the delivery of safe, evidence-based, family-centred care and support excellence in paediatric nursing practice.

In this role, you will:

Deliver advanced, patient-centred nursing care for paediatric patients with complex health needs.

Provide clinical leadership, mentorship, and support to nursing staff.

Coordinate and evaluate patient care in collaboration with the multidisciplinary team.

Promote evidence-based practice and participate in clinical quality improvement initiatives.

Educate patients, families, students, and staff.

Maintain accurate clinical documentation and ensure compliance with organisational policies and professional standards.

Participate in service development, research, and professional practice activities.

For more information about this role, please view the Position Description

About You

We are looking for someone who has:

Current registration as a Registered Nurse with AHPRA.

Relevant postgraduate qualification in Paediatric Nursing.

Minimum three years' post-registration experience in paediatric nursing, including substantial experience in the relevant specialty.

Demonstrated advanced clinical knowledge and decision-making skills.

Excellent communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills.

Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.

Commitment to continuous quality improvement and professional development.

Applicants must have current Australian work rights. We are unable to consider applicants who do not meet this requirement.

Benefits

 

At Central Coast Local Health District, you'll be supported to grow, thrive, and succeed:

Work-Life Balance

.Accrued day off each month (ADO)

.17.5% annual leave loading

.Paid parental leave

Financial Benefits

Health & Wellbeing

.Free flu vaccinations

.Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family

Career Growth

Are you an experienced Registered Nurse looking for a role that offers autonomy, variety, and the opportunity to make a genuine difference in your community? Join the Hospital in the Home (HITH) team at Central Coast Local Health District and become part of an innovative service delivering high-quality acute care beyond the hospital walls. The HITH team currently has vacancy for both Permanent positions and Temporary positions.

About the Opportunity

As a Hospital in the Home Registered Nurse, you will provide comprehensive clinical care to patients across the Central Coast community. You will assess, plan, implement and evaluate patient care while working closely with medical specialists, GPs, allied health professionals, carers and community services to deliver seamless healthcare experiences.

This position plays a key role in delivering high-quality, hospital-level care to patients in their own homes or alternative community setting, promoting independence while improving health outcomes across the community. In this role you will:

Provide high-quality, patient-centred nursing care in patients' homes across the community.

Conduct clinical assessments, develop care plans, and deliver evidence-based treatments.

Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to coordinate safe, seamless patient care.

Educate and support patients and their carers, promoting independence and positive health outcomes.

For more information about this role, please view the Position Description 

About You

We are looking for someone who has:

Current registration as a Registered Nurse (Division 1) with AHPRA and a current Australian Driver Licence.

Recent experience in acute care nursing, or a strong interest in developing their acute care expertise.

Excellent clinical assessment, care planning and case management skills.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work both autonomously and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.

A commitment to evidence-based practice, continuous improvement and delivering exceptional patient-centred care.

Applicants must have current work rights in Australia or be a permanent resident or citizen. Unfortunately, we cannot consider applicants who do not meet this requirement.

This privatly owned practice has been open for 25  years and has a strong reputation for providing quality health services to the residents 

 Fully accredited practice with a team of General Practitioners, along with a comprehensive range of Allied Health, specialists and diagnostic services provided on-site. 

 Whilst the medical centre provides a broad range of general family medical services, many of the doctors have special interests, and they cater for each of these by incorporating clinics in; skin cancer, occupational health, cosmetic, and women's health. 

   

 This  purpose built, state of the art facility with street front access. They are a fully air-conditioned centre with 21 consulting rooms, spacious waiting rooms, 4 treatment rooms (including two procedure rooms), 4 psychologist rooms, a range of allied health suites, a staff room, staff toilets, and a meeting room. We have a Pathology Collection centre, Radiology and Pharmacy all on-site. 

   

  PATIENT DEMAND  

 Exceptionally high demand for our services, and all doctors are kept busy with a constant flow of patients during their working hours. 

   

   

  TREATMENT ROOM  

 Four treatment rooms, two of which are designed as procedural rooms. Skin cancer clinic at the practice, so we are also interested in talking with doctors who would like to specialise in skin cancer checks and procedures, with all the essential equipment on-site including; an audiometry machine, spirometer, alcohol breath testing, and all emergency and skin cancer related equipment. Our nurses have also been trained in the management of fractures with plaster and fibreglass. 

   

  ADMIN SETUP  

 Fully computerised and accredited facility, using Medical Director and Pracsoft. Two practice managers, an accountant, and a large team of reception staff to provide all of the administrative support you need. 

   

  NURSING SERVICES  

 Full-time Registered Nurses, who have all been fully trained in General Practice Nursing. They can perform all general practice nursing duties and in addition have been trained to administer plaster and fibreglass of non-displaced fractures. 

   

  ALLIED HEALTH SERVICES  

 Wide range of Allied health staff onsite, including four Psychologists, two Dieticians, three Dentists, three Physiotherapists, two Exercise Physiologists, a Chiropractor, a Podiatrist, and an Audiology Clinic. 

   

  DIAGNOSTIC SERVICES  

 Practice has a SydPath Collection centre onsite, available for extended hours, seven days per week. Radiology centre onsite for X-Rays, which is open seven days per week. 

   

  OTHER CLINICAL SERVICES  

 Practice has a large and well-established Skin Cancer Clinic. We have a number of doctors interested in occupational health, and we also have a cosmetic clinic and women's health clinic. 

   

   

  BILLING ARRANGEMENTS  

 Our practice Bulk-Bills for all eligible services. 

  Essential Criteria  

 
	 Strong verbal and written communication skills 
	 Vocational Registration (FRACGP | FACRRM | FRNZCGP) 
	 Full Australian Work Rights
